topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can hardly believe it. Up in the attic, buried under layers of dust and neglect, they left it all. Old furniture, broken toys, piles of ancient magazines—like they just didn't care what a mess they were leaving behind. Now, it's all on me to sort through this junk. It's not just the time; it's the principle of the thing. How could anyone be so careless? I've got to clean this up, don't I? It's my responsibility now, even if it shouldn't be. I suppose I'll start with the largest pieces, get those out of the way, and then see what's salvageable. It's going to be a long day, and an even longer weekend.
